done_when: A test broadcast with an allowlisted cmd, sent while only the loop runs on a host, is executed once and acked done within 15 minutes; a non-allowlisted cmd is not run and shows in mts_doctor BROADCAST; tests cover failure, repeat-run and restart.
goal: A host that runs the live `mts_run loop` but no Claude session (the Lenovo) acks and runs HIGH broadcast commands that are on an allowlist, so a broadcast no longer waits for a session that never comes.
